1qisaa.source: Hand-curated seed + PD facsimile diplomatic excerpts

initial_units.original: קול קורא במדבר פנו דרך יהוה ישרו בערבה מסלה לאלהינו
initial_units.original_label: Hebrew consonantal text of this line (Masoretic vocalization for display; scroll lacks full pointing)
initial_units.original_source: Standard Isaiah 40:3 consonants; compare 1QIsaᵃ plate (Leon Levy / DJD X)
initial_units.english: A voice calls, "In the wilderness, prepare the way of Yahweh! Make a level highway in the desert for our God."
initial_units.english_source: World English Bible (PD), adapted to match shown Hebrew locus

initial_units.original: קול אמר קרא ואמר מה יקרא כל הבשר חציר וכל חסדו כציץ השדה יבש חציר נבל ציץ נבל כי רוח יהוה נשבה בו אכן חציר העם
initial_units.original_label: Excerpt from column XL (Isaiah 40) — diplomatic consonants for display
initial_units.original_source: Compare DJD X / Leon Levy 1QIsaᵃ facsimile
initial_units.english: A voice says, "Cry out!" One said, "What shall I cry?" "All flesh is like grass, and all its glory is like the flower of the field. The grass withers, the flower fades, because Yahweh's breath blows on it. Surely the people are grass."
